preregistered.purpose: craft axis on undamaged pairs, terrain held constant.
preregistered.pairs: step2_v1 (no library) vs step2 (library+loop) for house, tower, wall, inn
preregistered.question: Which of these two buildings is better made? A or B, one sentence.
preregistered.metric: agreement with the orchestrator's own blind picks, recorded before any judgement: house=v1, tower=v1, wall=step2, inn=v1. Note these contradict the project's proxy-based library>>no-library label on 3 of 4, which is itself at issue: the label came from family counts, never from looking.
preregistered.reading: 3-4/4 agreement, few ties = judge has a craft axis on undamaged pairs. Mostly ties = fine-craft preference weak (consistent with E1d blind spots). Systematic disagreement with both me and the proxies = judge has an axis but an alien one -- examine reasons.
preregistered.blind_picks: recorded before any judgement: house=v1, tower=v1, wall=library, inn=v1 -- three of the four contradict the project's own proxy-based library>>no-library label, which is what was at issue
